# Ion Mikel Liberal



I am a PhD student at the Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (IIIA-CSIC), where I study MaxSAT from both practical and theoretical perspectives. My research focuses on the design of new algorithms within the SAT-based paradigm, as well as on understanding their strengths and limitations through the lens of proof complexity. Outside my main research area, I am deeply interested in pure logic and the foundations of mathematics.
